fine_config_description: Configure fine rules and penalties for the library system.
standard_borrowing_period_help: Default borrowing duration for all books
grace_period_help: Number of days after due date before fines start applying
maximum_billable_days_help: Maximum days for fine calculation (capped system)
fine_per_day_help: Current: Rp {{amount}} per day per book
max_fine_per_item_help: Maximum fine amount per individual item
max_fine_per_borrowing_help: Maximum total fine per borrowing transaction
lost_book_payment_deadline_help: Days allowed to pay lost book fine
max_fine_cap_help: Maximum fine amount (optional, leave empty for unlimited)
late_return_fine_desc: Calculated based on days overdue × fine per day × quantity. Grace period is applied first.
lost_book_fine_desc: Fixed amount per lost book as configured above. Stock will NOT be restored for lost books.
borrowing_status_desc: If there are unpaid fines, borrowing status will be "awaiting_fine_payment" until all fines are settled.
member_blocking_desc: Members with unpaid fines cannot create new borrowings.
